summary.title: Assemble a broker submission candidate dry-run
summary.why: Main needs a clean readonly normalized request that can become a dry-run broker submission envelope without any approval or live dispatch.
summary.scope: Readonly validation and candidate assembly only, with no broker call and no runtime mutation.
summary.impact: The resulting envelope remains a repo-side submission candidate and proves the chain can advance one layer past intake.

requested_host_ops.justification: Carry a readonly health check as part of the dry-run broker submission candidate.
Carry readonly rollback metadata without executing any rollback.

evidence_refs.description: Design anchor for a broker submission candidate that remains dry-run only.
Artifact contract requiring declarative host-change intent.

required_evidence.description: Validation output for the candidate case before main routes it.
